tool: rclone v1.74.1-DEV (alpine package in bunkarr:dev, linux/arm64)

servers.sftp: atmoz/sftp:alpine@sha256:a81ea210713555be76075b4b2788a4addfaa54d137cd881f3a99ac539f0be2c5 (internal-sftp chroot: no shell, so no remote hashes)

config: RCLONE_CONFIG=/dev/null plus RCLONE_CONFIG_<NAME>_<OPTION> env (MINIO: type=s3 provider=Minio; BKSFTP: type=sftp key_file known_hosts_file; MCRYPT: type=crypt remote=minio:rclone-crypt/bunkarr password/password2 obscured). A remote defined only by env is shown with a config hash suffix, e.g. minio{Ajh92}, mcrypt{vm1ng}
secrets: throw-away values only; debug-vv-logs-env-secrets.txt has them replaced by FIXTURE-* placeholders
logFlags: --use-json-log --stats 1s --stats-log-level NOTICE -v unless noted; the log goes to stderr
notes: JSON log line: {time, level, msg, source, [object, objectType, size, skipped]}; the stats line has msg (multi-line text) and stats {bytes, checks, deletedDirs, deletes, elapsedTime, errors, eta, fatalError, listed, renames, retryError, serverSideCopies, serverSideCopyBytes, serverSideMoveBytes, serverSideMoves, speed, totalBytes, totalChecks, totalTransfers, transferTime, transfers, [transferring: [{bytes, dstFs, eta, group, name, percentage, size, speed, speedAvg, srcFs}]]}
dry run: level notice, skipped = copy | move | delete | move into backup dir
check/cryptcheck --combined lines: '= ' match, '* ' differ, '- ' missing on dst, '+ ' missing on src, '! ' error
hard links are copied once per name (two 3000000 B objects)
empty source dirs are not created (no --create-empty-src-dirs)

copy-after-kill.jsonl.cmd: re-run of rclone copy /src4 after kill -9 mid-transfer: finished files skipped, the cut file re-sent whole

check-differences.txt.cmd: rclone check ... --one-way after a change (text log)

sync-backup-dir.jsonl.cmd: same without --dry-run: replaced and deleted files are server-side moved into the dated dir

sync-max-delete.jsonl.cmd: rclone sync /src5 minio:rclone-plain/md/ --max-delete 1 (2 deletes needed; 1 is done before the stop)

bwlimit-invalid.txt.cmd: rclone copy ... --bwlimit '25:00,1M' (first and last line; usage text between removed)

check-on-crypt-size-only.txt.cmd: rclone check /src mcrypt:current --one-way ('hashes could not be checked': size only, still exit 0)

crypt-wrong-password.txt.cmd: rclone ls mcrypt: -v with a wrong password: names skipped at NOTICE, empty listing

sftp-check-no-hashes.txt.cmd: rclone check /src bksftp:upload/rclone-current --one-way (no hashes on a chroot sftp server)

exit3-source-not-found.txt.cmd: rclone copy /nonexistent minio:rclone-plain/x (copyto of a missing file: same)

exit1-bad-credentials.txt.cmd: rclone copy with a wrong secret_access_key --retries 1 --low-level-retries 1

exit10-max-duration-soft.txt.cmd: rclone copy /src6 (2 x 20 MiB) --bwlimit 4M --transfers 1 --max-duration 3s --cutoff-mode soft (first file finished, second not started)

lsjson-stat-missing-object-s3.json.cmd: rclone lsjson --stat minio:rclone-plain/nope.txt (a missing S3 object stats as a directory)

debug-vv-logs-env-secrets.txt.cmd: rclone lsd mcrypt: -vv | grep 'from environment variable' (secrets replaced by placeholders): -vv logs every env config value in clear
